title: The Robot Who Wanted to Dance
author: Hamidreza Rostami
moral_lesson: You do not have to be perfect to feel joy — just brave enough to try.
short_description: The best sorting robot in the factory discovers music, and something inside him wants to move.
long_description: Bolt is the best sorting robot in the whole factory. He never misses and he never drops a single gear. But one day he hears music drifting from the break room, and something inside him wants to move. Spark tells him he can be a sorting robot AND a dancer. At first his systems flash a warning: ERROR. NOT PROGRAMMED FOR THIS FUNCTION. But when no one is looking, Bolt tries one small step. Then another. And he discovers the very best thing of all to sort: joy.
